repos_data.description: Production ready toolkit to run AI locally
Production-grade C++ edge AI engine for video analytics and on-device VLM across Sophon, Rockchip RKNN, and x86, with visual orchestration, real-time OSD, events, and reproducible benchmarks.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.

A local-first workspace for documents, tasks and meetings on macOS — nested spaces, typed properties, relations and saved views, with transcription, Smart Minutes and an agent running entirely on-device via MLX on Apple Silicon

Thai + English voice typing for Mac. Offline speech-to-text that types Thai-spoken tech words in English. Push-to-talk dictation on Apple Silicon (Whisper + MLX), free & open-source Wispr Flow alternative · พิมพ์ด้วยเสียงภาษาไทย
Hands-free on-device voice loop for macOS: Apple SFSpeechRecognizer + cloned-voice TTS, continuous listening, zero cloud. Originally built to drive claude-code-local.

Qwen3.8-27B on one laptop CPU: up to 2.52 token/s, 8 GB tested, no runtime accuracy loss. Native OpenAI-compatible API with function tools; no GPU or Python. | 单颗笔记本 CPU 运行 Qwen3.8-27B：最快 2.52 token/s，最低 8 GB 内存可运行，推理加速不牺牲准确性。原生 OpenAI 兼容接口支持函数工具；无需 GPU 或 Python。
A local-first, AI-integrated clipboard manager for macOS. Semantic search, on-device AI, and credentials that delete themselves.

The free, open-source, on-device Grammarly alternative for Mac and Windows. Spelling, grammar, tone checks and rewrites in Slack, Teams, Outlook, Mail & Zoom — powered by Apple Intelligence and Windows Phi Silica; your text never leaves your device.
Free, open-source AI meeting notes for Mac: transcribes any call and writes the minutes on your Mac. No bot, no cloud, no account.
